**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no take-or-pay or minimum purchase obligation on Clear Capital:

- **§ 3(a)** — compensation is strictly time-and-materials "as set forth in each Statement of Work," with no committed spend or minimum retainer.
- **§ 1(a)** — Contractor is retained "on a task by task basis," with Services and fees defined per SOW, so fees attach only to ordered work.
- **§ 3(b)** — invoicing is based on dates of Services and hours actually worked.
- **§ 6(a)/(b)** — either party may terminate for convenience on 15 days' notice when no SOW is outstanding, and on termination Contractor is paid only fees "incurred or earned" through the effective date — no shortfall charge or penalty.

Targeted searches for "minimum," "commit," "shortfall," "take or pay," "retainer," "non-refundable," "guaranteed," and "volume" surfaced nothing binding our side (the only "exclusive" hits relate to IP ownership and the entire-agreement clause). This satisfies the preferred position, so no edit is warranted.

One adjacent point worth noting for a different rule, not this one: § 6(a) convenience termination is only available when no SOW is outstanding, so mid-SOW exit depends on the SOW terms. That is a termination-rights issue rather than a minimum-commitment deviation, and it does not create take-or-pay exposure given the incurred-fees-only payment cap.
